title: Arts & Music
intro: Music and the arts: how music works, and how to play it.

items: Music Theory (#/arts/music-theory): Music theory explains why music sounds the way it does: how pitches relate, how rhythm is organised, how chords move and how whole pieces are built.
Guitar (#/arts/guitar): The guitar is a fretted string instrument: six strings over a neck divided by metal frets into semitones.
Songwriting and Composition (#/arts/songwriting): Theory explains how music works; this topic is about using it to make your own.
